summary: The CDNI Request Routing Redirection interface lets an upstream CDN ask whether a downstream CDN could handle a user request, and lets the downstream one advertise its footprint and capabilities. This proposed standard defines the redirection part so user requests can be sent to the best interconnected CDN.

eli5.summary: If one pizza shop cannot deliver to your street, it can pass your order to a partner shop that can. This defines how the shops ask each other and answer.
